# netcup_clouddns_records (Data Source)

Reads records from the active netcup CloudDNS revision. Does not create or commit revisions. Requires clouddns_api_key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_clouddns_records" "example" {
  domain_id = 12345
}

output "clouddns_records" {
  value = data.netcup_clouddns_records.example.records
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (Number) Domain ID from netcup_clouddns_domains.

### Read-Only

- `records` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `identifier` (String) Record identifier in this revision.
- `immutable` (Boolean) Whether this is a system-managed, immutable record.
- `name` (String) Record name relative to the zone.
- `rdata` (String) Record data in DNS presentation format.
- `ttl` (Number) TTL in seconds; may be null for system records.
- `type` (String) DNS record type.
